subject: general
question: P is the son of C. C is married to D. D is the sister of O. O is the daughter of M. X is the mother of C and married to W. How is P related to W?
solution:
By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/496368278e51fd33f2bee9b301a733a33389bdc9d0f2d4fae5af0b40056affd1.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/61cedf885d50d57f9e48b41480cd6fc5864b015bb7a1786197020af35392efc0.png] ​

W is father of C and P is son of C.

Therefore, P is W's son's son.

Hence, ‘Son's son’ is the correct answer.
